name: openbb_equity_calendar_dividend
description:
Upcoming dividend events across the market through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.calendar.dividend).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): start_date and end_date (provider's default window when omitted); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, nasdaq; default nasdaq).
One company: openbb_dividends, yf_dividends. Keys: nasdaq needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"start_date": "2026-10-12", "end_date": "2026-10-16"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
